$comment: The market eval's floors (README.md, Floors). Scores are pass counts and only go up; speed ceilings are median ms and only go down. Measured on CI's own runner: the market-floors workflow runs the eval 3 times and check.mjs --raise takes the worst. A change that lowers anything here or in cli/test/dom-bench/floor.json fails CI unless the pull request has the floor-lowered label.
